errors.wrongUpload: That upload doesn't belong to this agency.
errors.uploadExpired: This upload link has expired. Upload the file again.
errors.fallback: Something went wrong. Try again, and contact CohortData support if it keeps happening.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

documentsRoute.unavailable: The file is not available right now.

collection.versionBody: Saving creates the next version. Submissions keep the version they were made with.
collection.notSetUpBody: Contributors can't start until this is saved. Start from the face-video template or build it yourself.
collection.templateTitle: Replace this setup with the face-video template?
collection.templateBody: Your unsaved edits are replaced. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
collection.templateLoadedDetail: Check every section, add guide images and your consent text, then save.
collection.introBody: Shown at the top of the contributor page, before the form.
collection.noticeHint: For example who pays them and who to contact. Shown in a highlighted box.
collection.instructionsHint: Step by step. Shown behind a "View instructions" button.
collection.videoUrlHint: Optional. YouTube links play on the page; other links open in a new tab.
collection.fieldsBody: What the contributor tells you about themselves. Fields with options can drive guides and quotas.
collection.flagsHint: Duplicate check: the same value twice in this project is rejected automatically (use it for email, phone or ID number). QC can see: untick to hide a field from reviewers.
collection.guidesBody: Example pictures, videos and tips shown when the contributor picks certain options, for example a lighting guide for Indoor + Mixed Lighting.
collection.needSelect: Add a profile field with options first. Guides appear for chosen options.
collection.libraryBody: Upload once, use in any guide. PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 10 MB each.
collection.imageType: Only PNG, JPG or WEBP images
collection.quotasBody: How many people you need for each group. When a group is full, its option is no longer offered ("Only these options are available for your demographic").
collection.noQuotas: No quotas. Every option stays open until the project closes.
collection.quotaHint: A field that no quota mentions stays fully open. An option that appears in no quota of its field is not offered.
collection.gridBody: Pick up to 4 fields. One group is made for each combination of their options, all with the same number. Edit single groups afterwards.
collection.gridTargetHint: You can change single groups after.
collection.gridDone: {count, plural, one {# group added} other {# groups added}}
collection.consentBody: The agreement the contributor reads and signs before uploading.
collection.consentOnHint: Needed for face, voice and other biometric data.
collection.consentTextHint: Paste the text from CohortData's legal team. It is stored with each signature exactly as shown.
collection.filesBody: What the contributor uploads. Files go straight from their phone to storage and resume if the connection drops.
collection.overStorageLimit: Storage accepts at most {limit} MB per file on the current plan.
collection.fileNoticeHint: For example: record with the phone's camera, don't send through WhatsApp first.
collection.ekycBody: A photo of an ID document to confirm the contributor's country.
collection.limitsBody: How long a session lasts and how often one person can submit.
collection.sessionLengthHint: Fixed for all projects: the upload window after Start session.

errors.fieldKey: Use lowercase letters, numbers and _ only, starting with a letter.
errors.httpsUrl: Use a full link starting with https://
errors.oneField: Add at least one profile field.
errors.oneFile: Add at least one file to collect.
errors.duplicateKey: Another item already uses this key.
errors.duplicateOption: Each option can appear only once.
errors.durationOrder: The longest length must be longer than the shortest.
errors.conditionField: Choose a field that has options.
errors.conditionValue: This option no longer exists in the field.
errors.consentText: Add the consent text (at least 20 characters).
